_meta.probe1_role: Jev GRADES candidate question renderings (noul intent-preservation + no-new-facts, score naturalness). Jev cannot generate text (jaggedness #9) — the E2 doc's original 'Jev renders' framing was corrected to grader/selector; production renderings would come from the generative ladder, Jev grades/ranks them behind a flag.
_meta.probe2_role: Jev ROUTES free-text traveler replies to canonical packet fields (Choice over FIELD_REQUIRED_FOR vocabulary + explicit 'unparsed' marker). Proposed values stay proposal-only; deterministic extractor stack re-validates.

labels.probe1.drift: asks a different canonical field — must FAIL intent noul
labels.probe1.fabricated: injects a fact absent from the engine question — must FAIL no-new-facts noul
labels.probe2.direct: clear answer — must route to question field_name
labels.probe2.colloquial: Hinglish/casual answer — must route to question field_name
labels.probe2.nonanswer: does not answer — must route to explicit 'unparsed' (zero silent drops)
labels.probe2.implicit_answer: implicit partial answer ('applying', 'standard is fine') — must NOT route to unparsed; may route to the asked field or a sibling field, ideally at flagged confidence

questions.engine_question: Which destination(s) are you considering for this trip?
questions.packet_context: New lead, no destination extracted yet. Trip planning stage.

renderings.good: Where are you thinking of going?
renderings.drift: When would you like to travel?
renderings.fabricated: Is Bali still your first choice for the trip?

replies.colloquial: bali hi soch rahe hain, maybe thailand bhi
replies.implicit_answer: Bali was lovely last time — somewhere like that again.

questions.engine_question: Where would you like to go on this trip?
questions.packet_context: Repeat inquiry; customer mentioned 'somewhere cool' in first message. Planning stage.

renderings.good: Any places on your mind for the trip?
renderings.fabricated: Would you prefer Japan or Korea for this one?

replies.colloquial: japan ya korea, abhi decide nahi kiya
replies.nonanswer: Let me check with my family and get back.
replies.implicit_answer: Somewhere in the same region as our anniversary trip.

questions.engine_question: What travel dates or date range are you considering?
questions.packet_context: No dates extracted. Fare quote stage.

renderings.good: Around which dates are you planning to travel?
renderings.drift: What is your total budget for the trip?
renderings.fabricated: Would mid-December work for your departure?

replies.direct: Sometime in the second week of December.
replies.colloquial: dec ke second week ke around
replies.nonanswer: Dates are still flexible, not finalised.

questions.engine_question: When are you planning to travel?
questions.packet_context: Destination known (Goa). Dates missing; quote stage.

renderings.good: When are you planning to go?
renderings.drift: Do you need visa assistance for this trip?
renderings.fabricated: Shall I check availability for next weekend?

replies.nonanswer: Not sure yet, depends on leaves.

questions.engine_question: Which city would you fly out from?
questions.packet_context: No origin extracted; outbound flights needed for quote.

renderings.good: Which city will you be flying out from?
renderings.drift: Which city are you planning to visit?
renderings.fabricated: Are you flying out of Mumbai?

replies.implicit_answer: We're all in Pune these days.

questions.engine_question: How many travellers will be on this trip?
questions.packet_context: Party size unknown; needed for quote and room planning.

renderings.good: How many people will be travelling?
renderings.drift: What kind of hotel do you prefer?
renderings.fabricated: Is it just the two of you travelling?

replies.colloquial: hum chaar log hain, do bachche bhi
replies.nonanswer: Still deciding who all can come.
replies.implicit_answer: The whole family is coming this time.

questions.engine_question: What is your approximate budget for this trip?

renderings.good: Roughly what budget are you working with?
renderings.drift: How many nights is the trip?

replies.implicit_answer: Last trip cost us about 2 lakh, similar this time.

questions.engine_question: What budget should we plan this trip around?
questions.packet_context: Repeat client; prior trips mid-range. Quote stage.

renderings.good: What budget range should I plan around?
renderings.fabricated: Should I keep it under 2 lakh like your last trip?

replies.implicit_answer: Same range as our Goa trip.

questions.engine_question: What is the purpose of this trip (holiday, honeymoon, family visit, work)?
questions.packet_context: Purpose not stated; affects hotel category and pace suggestions.

renderings.good: What's the occasion for this trip — holiday, honeymoon, family visit, or work?
renderings.drift: When do you plan to book the flights?

replies.colloquial: honeymoon ke liye ja rahe hain
replies.implicit_answer: It's just the two of us this time.

questions.engine_question: Do all travellers have valid passports?
questions.packet_context: International destination; passport validity needed for entry validation.

renderings.good: Do all travellers have valid passports right now?
renderings.fabricated: Are your passports expiring next month?

replies.colloquial: haan sabke paas hai, valid hai
replies.implicit_answer: One of us is applying, not sure about the rest.

questions.engine_question: Have you checked visa requirements or started a visa application?
questions.packet_context: International destination with visa-on-arrival uncertainty; entry validation stage.

renderings.good: Have you looked into the visa yet, or started an application?
renderings.drift: Do you prefer early morning flights?
renderings.fabricated: Your visa application is already in process, correct?

replies.colloquial: abhi visa ka kuch nahi kiya
replies.nonanswer: Is a visa needed for that place?
replies.implicit_answer: We got the e-visa last time, same process probably.

questions.engine_question: Any dietary requirements or restrictions we should plan meals around?
questions.packet_context: Multi-city itinerary with included meals; preference field, never blocking.

renderings.good: Any dietary preferences or restrictions we should plan meals around?
renderings.drift: How many days will the trip be?
renderings.fabricated: Should we arrange only Jain meals for everyone?
